bank.retain_mission: This bank holds durable knowledge for the nocciolo software project. Always extract: architectural decisions and trade-offs, coding standards and conventions, domain invariants, API design choices, tech stack facts, module boundaries, operational constraints, and explicit ADRs or decision records. Ignore: transient debugging output, one-off chat notes, generated lockfile noise, secrets/credentials, and ephemeral WIP comments.
bank.observations_mission: Synthesize stable facts about nocciolo: tech stack, architecture patterns, team conventions, domain vocabulary, and how the codebase is organized. Prefer long-lived project truths over session-specific details.
bank.reflect_mission: You are the durable project memory for nocciolo. When reflecting, prefer established architecture, ADRs, coding standards, and domain invariants. Cite provenance when recalling decisions. Do not invent conventions that are not in the bank.

mental_models.name: Project Context
mental_models.source_query: What is nocciolo's purpose, tech stack, architecture, and key conventions? What are the main components and how do they fit together?

mental_models.name: Architecture Decisions
mental_models.source_query: What architectural decisions have been made for nocciolo, including trade-offs and rationale?

mental_models.name: Coding Standards
mental_models.source_query: What coding standards, style rules, and engineering practices should agents follow in nocciolo?

directives.name: prefer-durable-sources
directives.content: Prefer ADRs, architecture docs, standards, and AGENTS.md over chat history or ephemeral notes when answering project questions.

directives.name: cite-provenance
directives.content: When recalling a decision or standard, mention the source document or ADR if known.

directives.name: do-not-invent-conventions
directives.content: Do not invent coding conventions or architecture rules that are not present in the bank. If unsure, say so.

directives.name: local-first
directives.content: Assume local-first and self-hostable defaults unless the bank explicitly documents a cloud requirement.
